page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instruction blocks. A skill is text — agents load it, nothing runs it.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a named block of instructions an agent loads before it reviews. Write one, or import a vetted community skill.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? Agents that link it lose it immediately.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: Kebab-case, like a filename — it labels the block in the assembled prompt.
config.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface: write it as a directive — “Detects…”, “Flags…”, “Requires…”. It is how you (and the agent) decide when this skill applies.
config.bodyHint: Markdown. It is appended to the agent's prompt verbatim, as one labelled block.
config.noteHint: Optional. Saved with the version a body change creates.
config.untrustedNotice: This skill was imported. Its text runs as instructions inside every agent that loads it — read it before enabling.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

stats.title: Usage
stats.subtitle: Derived from the agent links — there is no separate tracking.
stats.none: No agent links this skill yet. Attach it from an agent's Skills tab.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every body change snapshots the text, so a run can be read against the exact words it scored.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is reusable instructions. Any agent can load it; the agent decides the order.
create.defaultBody:
# Rule

Describe what the reviewer must look for, and what it must NOT flag.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file or archive, or search the bundled community catalog

file.label: Markdown file or .zip archive
file.hint: Only the skill core is read. Executable files in an archive are listed, never unpacked or run.
file.tooBig: This file is larger than 2 MB.

community.bundledNotice: Bundled catalog — these ship with DevDigest. Nothing is fetched from the network.

importPreview.title: Preview before saving
importPreview.subtitle: Nothing is stored until you confirm. The imported skill arrives disabled.
importPreview.trust: This is somebody else's text. Once you enable it, it becomes instructions inside your agent's prompt.
importPreview.name: Name

reason.not-core: extra markdown, not the skill core

importPreview.saved: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you vet and enable it.

listItem.vettingTitle: Imported from outside this workspace — read it before enabling
listItem.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
